run: set -eux; tmux_version=3.8; tmux_sha256=e79c699c7e949dccd0a4a125e17b8d1261e311b16979dbc8eb34542f3966d82e; build_deps='bison libevent-dev libjemalloc-dev libncurses-dev libsystemd-dev'; apt-get update; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends $build_deps; mkdir -p /tmp/tmux-build; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/tmux/tmux/releases/download/$tmux_version/tmux-$tmux_version.tar.gz" -o /tmp/tmux-build/tmux.tar.gz; echo "$tmux_sha256  /tmp/tmux-build/tmux.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c; tar -xzf /tmp/tmux-build/tmux.tar.gz -C /tmp/tmux-build --strip-components=1; (cd /tmp/tmux-build && ./configure --prefix=/usr --sysconfdir=/etc --enable-systemd --enable-jemalloc && make -j"$(nproc)" && make install); apt-mark manual $(ldd /usr/bin/tmux | awk '$3 ~ "^/" { print $3 }' | xargs -r readlink -f | xargs -r dpkg -S | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u); apt-get purge -y --auto-remove $build_deps; rm -rf /tmp/tmux-build /var/lib/apt/lists/*; tmux -V | grep -Fx "tmux $tmux_version"
